Class MainView

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
moldsim.view.MainView
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class MainView extends javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
Main JavaFX view of the Mold Simulation application.

This class defines the full user interface layout including: left environment controls, central grid visualization, right event controls, and bottom simulation controls. It acts as the primary UI container for all interactive components.
